metaTitle: Custom Gray Pet Collars | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gray pet collars for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing on branded gray pet collars.
introHtml: Gray pet collars offer a neutral, professional look that complements any brand color without clashing. Whether you are outfitting service animals, creating welcome kits for new pet owners, or supplying company merchandise for a pet-friendly workplace, gray collars provide a versatile canvas for screen-printed or embroidered logos. The subdued tone keeps the focus on your brand mark while blending seamlessly with any coat color.
heroAltText: Custom gray pet collars with embroidered logo on a neutral background for bulk orders.
